Class SafeMacroClimat

  • java.lang.Object
    • safe.model.SafeMacroClimat
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable

    public class SafeMacroClimat
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.io.Serializable
    MACRO CLIMAT parameters Weather data for a simulation (day by day) Each day is an instance of SafeDailyClimat

        public void createDailyClimat(SafeGeneralParameters generalParameters,
                              float latitude,
                              int julian,
                              int year,
                              int realYear,
                              int month,
                              int day,
                              float tmin,
                              float tmax,
                              float rhmin,
                              float rhmax,
                              float globalRad,
                              float rain,
                              float windSpeed,
                              float waterTableDepth,
                              float co2)
        Add a new daily weather in macro climat
        Parameters:
        generalParameters - Reference to SafeGeneralParameters object
        latitude - Latitude of the plot
        julian - Julian day of the climatic entry
        year - Year of the climatic entry
        realYear - Real year of the climatic entry
        month - Month of the climatic entry
        day - Day of the climatic entry
        tmin - Temperature min of the climatic entry (degree)
        tmax - Temperature max of the climatic entry (degree)
        rhmin - Relative humidity min of the climatic entry (%)
        rhmax - Relative humidity max of the climatic entry (%)
        globalRad - Global radiation of the climatic entry (MJ m-2)
        rain - Rain of the climatic entry (mm)
        windSpeed - Wind speed (m s-1)
        waterTableDepth - Water table depth of the climatic entry (m)
        co2 - CO2 concentration of the climatic entry (ppm)

        public static void rainTreatement(SafeStand stand,
